name: Large Rodents
description: Large rodents are the giants of the rodent order: the capybaras and the beavers, herbivore Mammals that live along rivers, lakes and wetlands.$(br2)They are strong swimmers with ever-growing, orange-enamelled incisors, and they escape danger by diving into the water.$(br2)During the Pleistocene, both groups had giant relatives the size of a bear.
